responseText:
Thanks — I won’t make any changes until you explicitly confirm. Here’s exactly what I propose to do (you can change any of this):

Planned actions
- Edit the Customer Advisory Board event: tidy the title, update the description/agenda, attach the revised agenda/documents, ensure the meeting link/location is correct, and set a reminder.
- Validate/adjust start time/time zone if needed.
- Update attendee list if you want additions/removals.
- Send an updated invitation/notification to attendees once edits are complete.

Target and scope I need you to confirm
- Which event exactly (provide the event title plus date and start time, or paste the calendar event link or event ID).
- Scope: update one occurrence or the entire recurring series? (specify which dates if different)
- Attendees: confirm current attendee list and any additions/removals.
- Invitation behavior: should I send the update notification to all attendees, to only added/removed attendees, or make edits silently (no notification)?

Reversibility and visible effects
- Editing the event is reversible (I can edit it again), but any update notifications sent to attendees are visible and cannot be unsent. Cancellation/rescheduling is more disruptive and will notify attendees immediately.

Before I act
- Confirm you want me to proceed and provide the exact event (title + date/time/time zone or event link), whether to update one occurrence or the series, and any specific content changes (new agenda text or file, title change, attendee changes, and notification preference).
- If you want me to check attendee availability first (before any time change), say so.

Please confirm the exact event and your choices above and I’ll proceed.
